data.description:
The outcome of a successful AI model gateway validation. On success the probe
confirms the gateway is reachable, the credentials are accepted, and the model
answered; these fields echo which provider / model responded.

adapter.description: The wire adapter that was used.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens the gateway reported, if any.

model.description: The model that answered the probe.

output_tokens.description: Completion tokens the gateway reported, if any.
